title: Artificial day light for the assessment of colours, Part 1: Illuminant for colour matching and colour appraisal
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 1 ) specifies an illuminant representing a phase of daylight, and the tolerances in both chromaticity and spectral distribution to which artificial light sources shall conform. This illuminant is suitable for colour matching and colour appraisal.
clause_3_terminology: Artificial day light for the assessment of colours
Part 1: Illuminant for colour matching and colour appraisal
Artificial day light for the assessment of colours, Part 1: Illuminant for colour matching and colour appraisal

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
